svg.aria-label: Leaderboard final design. Game servers send signed score events to a score service, which validates them, writes the durable result to a database, and updates a Redis sorted set for each leaderboard (global, per region, per season) with ZADD or ZINCRBY. A sorted set keeps members ordered by score in a skip list, so the top 100 is ZREVRANGE and a player's rank is ZREVRANK, both logarithmic time. Very large boards are sharded by score range or approximated; friends leaderboards are computed on read from a small set. A CDN or cache serves the top 100 for a few seconds. The database is the source of truth for rebuilding the sorted sets.

svg.text: skip list: rank and range in O(log n)
